## Rule
Given an input grid of height H and width W, make an output of height 3H and width 2W by reflecting/tile-copying the grid:

- Horizontal: each output row is the corresponding source row reversed (left half) followed by that source row unchanged (right half).
- Vertical: output is three H-row bands. Band 0 uses input rows bottom-to-top; band 1 uses input rows top-to-bottom; band 2 uses input rows bottom-to-top. At boundaries, the edge row appears twice as adjacent bands meet; do not remove those repeats.
- Preserve cell colors exactly; no recoloring.

Equivalent mapping, for output row r, band k=floor(r/H), offset j=r mod H:
- source row s = H-1-j when k is even; s=j when k is odd.
- output row = reverse(input[s]) concatenated with input[s].
